rationale: Lactate-sulfate reduction is my primary metabolism. Lactate is abundant (28 mM) and I oxidize it to acetate while reducing sulfate to H₂S. Amino acids supplement nitrogen. Carbon balance: 30 mmol C in (lactate) → 14 mmol C out (acetate + CO₂) + 16 mmol C biomass (0.40 gDW/h × 43 mmol C/gDW).
